content: दक्षिण {%a.%} [दक्ष्-इनन् <ls>Uṇ. 2. 50.</ls>] .²1 Able, skilful, dexterous, competent, clever; इत्यम्बरीषं नाभागिमन्वमोदन्त दक्षिणाः <ls>Mb. 12. 29. 102</ls>. .²2 Right (<ab>opp.</ab> वाम). .²3 Situated on the right side. दक्षिणं परी, दक्षिणं कृ to place any one on the right side as a mark of respect; ग्रहर्क्षताराः परियन्ति दक्षिणम् <ls>Bhāg. 4. 12. 25</ls>. .²4 South, southern; as in दक्षिणवायु, दक्षिणदिक्; आददे नातिशीतोष्णो नभस्वानिव दक्षिणः <ls>R. 4. 8</ls>. .²5 Situated to the south. .²6 Sincere, straightforward, honest, impartial. .²7 Pleasing, amiable. .²8 Courteous, civil. .²9 Compliant, submissive. .²10 Dependent. .²11 Favourable; ‘दक्षिणः सरलावामपरच्छन्दानुवर्तिषु’ इति विश्वः; <ls>Ki. 18. 27</ls>. .{@-णः@} .²1 The right hand or arm. .²2 A civil or courteous person, applied in poetic compositions to a lover who professes attachment to one mistress, while his heart has been entirely taken up by another. .²3 An epithet of Śiva or Viṣṇu. .²4 The right-hand horse of a carriage; इन्द्रस्येव दक्षिणः श्रियैधि <ls>Vāj. 9. 8</ls>. .²5 The southern sacred fire. .{@-णः, णम्@} .²1 The right side. .²2 The south; <ls>Nala. 9. 23</ls>. .²3 The Deccan. .{@-णम्@} The highest doctrine of the {%Śāktas%}
